claim_updates.reason: V1_STREAMING_DECOMPRESSOR_POST_ACCUMULATION limitation resolved at the in-process decompressor API layer: brotli.Decompressor().process(chunk) and gzip.GzipFile.read(CHUNK_SIZE) produce byte-identical SHA256 output to full-body decompression across 480 multi-layer streaming observations (24 cells x 5 reps x 4 states), 240 regression, 120 identity — 840/840 correct, 0 errors, 0 silent fallbacks (audit PASS). Claim ceiling bounded to Python 3.12.14, brotli 1.2.0, stdlib gzip, in-process only, equal chunk sizes for outer/inner layers, sequential unwrapping, high-entropy payloads at 10KB/100KB nominal under GZIP-THEN-BROTLI and BROTLI-THEN-GZIP (depth 2 only). V2 identity baseline is tautological (passthrough, not via decompressor API). Real CDN infrastructure remains the mandatory remaining gate. Status remains EXPERIMENTAL because CDN correctness, payloads >100KB, depths 3-5, mixed chunk sizes, and cross-run reproducibility are unresolved.

product_action: None — CDN correctness gate remains open. Streaming decompressor API correctness validated on localhost; real CDN testing required before Product Core readiness.
next_question: Does iterative decompression correctness hold on real CDN infrastructure (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai free tier) with high-entropy multi-layer payloads, Accept-Encoding negotiation, auth-aware Vary/cache, geographic latency, and production concurrency at 8KB+ chunk sizes?
reason: All five frozen decision rule conditions pass: C1 streaming==fullbody 480/480, C2 streaming==expected 480/480, C3 single-layer regression 240/240 gzip + 240/240 brotli, C4 null control all_same=true, C5 compressed size 3/3 types meet thresholds. Audit PASS confirms all recomputed metrics match producer. However, the claim ceiling is strictly bounded: in-process decompressor API layer only (no HTTP, no network, no CDN), depth 2 stacked encodings only, equal chunk sizes, Python 3.12.14 + brotli 1.2.0. The inherited parent question about real CDN infrastructure is the sole remaining blocker for C-MEAS-VALID Product Core readiness and has not been addressed by this experiment.
